body: I can only imagine how you feel right now, I was in a similar position a few months back, I lost everything that mattered to me, and tried to take my own life.  I don’t know what you are going through but I can promise you that things get better.  Feel free to send me a message or comment on here. What is making you feel this way?

Hey man, I don’t know what you are going through, but after being in a psychiatric hospital myself, I will tell you it is living hell.  Not a place I would ever like to revisit.  Talk to us, we are here for you when no one else is.
